resolvedFindings.resolution: Try raw first; on a real QuotaExceededError only, encode the new archive losslessly. Preserve existing copies and primary-before-archive ordering; validate packed exports and expose actionable decode failure.

resolvedFindings.finding: Shared resource boundary did not independently enforce the aggregate facility workload ceiling.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Accumulate per-pool serving/training/general reservations, including headroom, across collector calls; retain physical and memory checks.

resolvedFindings.finding: A checksum-valid cumulative rehearsal receipt could remove its paid serving-profile binding and restore the base tariff.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Validate actual known grant pool and week with assertFacilityTariffGrant, including missing-binding cases, across rehearsal, guardrail, synthetic and batch consumers. Independent W590 forge now fails validation and import.

resolvedFindings.finding: Historical isolated policy fixtures granted every newly implemented discovery without a commissioned site or shipment.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Keep S5/S6 out of those old isolated fixtures; final guardrail, assurance and batch regressions pass under real eligibility rules.

resolvedFindings.finding: Initial facility tests assumed retained ledger facts, floating-point equality and compute-limited work despite real ML supervision.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Respect bounded ledger retention, integer conversion and the real staff limit; ordinary funded branches retain actual payments and readiness.

resolvedFindings.finding: A progressing retrofit displayed an instruction to assign staff.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Render positive current staff work and elapsed-only waiting as neutral progress without changing persisted core state.
